en.short_description: Reduce PDF file size online while keeping text sharp.
en.seo_title: Compress PDF - Reduce PDF File Size Online Free | PDFWala
en.seo_description: Compress PDF files online for free. Shrink large PDFs for email and upload while keeping text sharp. Choose your quality level. Files auto-delete in 2 hours.
en.intro: Reduce the size of a PDF in seconds - smaller files for email, faster uploads, and easier sharing, with text kept crisp and readable.
en.what: Compress PDF shrinks a PDF's file size by re-encoding and down-sampling the images inside it and cleaning up redundant data, without changing the page layout. Scanned documents and image-heavy PDFs often drop by 80-95%, while the text stays selectable and sharp. You choose how hard to compress: from a gentle, near-lossless pass to maximum compression for the smallest possible file.
en.why: Email providers reject attachments over 10-25 MB, portals cap uploads, and large PDFs are slow to open and share. A 30 MB scanned contract that won't send becomes a 2 MB file that attaches instantly - without you having to re-scan or retype anything. If a PDF is already optimized, we tell you honestly instead of degrading it for a meaningless gain.

steps.d: Drop your PDF into the box above or click to browse.
Pick a compression level - Recommended works for most files; Maximum makes the smallest file.
Click Compress PDF and we process it on our servers.
Grab your smaller PDF. It is deleted automatically within 2 hours.

features.d: Each level actually reduces size - we force image down-sampling so 'gentle' still saves space.
From near-lossless to maximum shrink, you decide the trade-off between size and clarity.
We compress images, not your text layer, so the document stays searchable and crisp.
Already-optimized files are left untouched with a clear note instead of a fake percentage.

benefits: Send large PDFs that were too big to email.
Upload to portals with strict size limits.
Save storage and speed up sharing.
No watermarks and no sign-up.
use_cases: Emailing a scanned contract or ID that exceeds the attachment limit.
Uploading a portfolio or report to a job or grant portal.
Shrinking a photo-heavy brochure before sending to a client.
Reducing a batch of scanned invoices for accounting software.
en.security: Your file is uploaded over an encrypted HTTPS connection, processed automatically on our own servers, and deleted within 2 hours. We never share or sell your documents, we never use them to train any model, and no human ever opens them. You do not need an account.

faqs.q: Will compressing reduce the quality of my PDF?
faqs.a: It depends on the level you pick. The gentle level is visually near-lossless; higher levels down-sample images more to save space. Text always stays sharp because we compress images, not text.

faqs.q: Why did my file only shrink a little?
faqs.a: Some PDFs - especially text-only or already-compressed exports - are already optimized. When that happens we keep the file at its original quality and tell you it is already optimized rather than degrade it for a negligible gain.

faqs.q: Is there a file size limit?
faqs.a: The free tier accepts files up to 10 MB. If your PDF is larger, try splitting it first or contact us.

faqs.q: Do you keep my files?
faqs.a: No. Files are processed automatically and deleted within 2 hours. Nothing is shared or used to train models.

faqs.q: Does it work on scanned PDFs?
faqs.a: Yes - scanned and image-heavy PDFs compress the most, often by 80-95%.

en.cta_p: Free, private, and no sign-up. Your file auto-deletes in 2 hours.

en.short_description: Combine multiple PDFs into one file in the order you choose.

en.seo_description: Combine multiple PDFs into one file online, free. Drag, drop and merge PDFs in the order you want. No watermark, no sign-up. Files auto-delete in 2 hours.
en.intro: Combine several PDFs into one clean document - in the exact order you choose - without installing anything.
en.what: Merge PDF joins two or more PDF files into a single document. The pages keep their original quality, fonts and orientation, and are placed one after another in the order you upload them. It is the fastest way to turn a pile of separate PDFs - chapters, receipts, signed pages - into one file you can send or archive.
en.why: Sharing five separate attachments looks messy and gets lost. A single merged PDF is easier to email, print, e-sign and file. Instead of asking the recipient to open six files in the right order, you hand them one document that is already in order.

steps.d: Add all the PDFs you want to combine - drag several in at once.
They merge top-to-bottom in the order listed; remove any you added by mistake.
Click Merge PDFs and we stitch them together on our servers.
Download the single combined PDF. It auto-deletes within 2 hours.

features.d: Combine as many PDFs as the size limit allows into one file.
Pages appear in the exact order you add the files.
Fonts, images and page sizes are carried over exactly.
Your merged file is clean - no branding stamped on your pages.

benefits: One tidy file instead of many attachments.
Easier to print, sign and archive.
Keeps every page's original quality.
Works on any device, no install.
use_cases: Combining signed contract pages back into one document.
Merging chapters or sections into a single report.
Joining scanned receipts for an expense claim.
Bundling a cover letter, resume and portfolio into one PDF.
en.security: Your files are uploaded over HTTPS, merged automatically on our servers, and deleted within 2 hours. We never share, sell or train on your documents, and no human opens them. No account needed.

faqs.q: In what order will my PDFs be combined?
faqs.a: In the order they appear in the list after you upload them - top to bottom. Remove and re-add a file if you need to change its position.

faqs.q: Is there a limit on how many files I can merge?
faqs.a: You can merge multiple files as long as the combined upload stays within the free-tier size limit.

faqs.q: Will merging change my page quality?
faqs.a: No. Pages are copied as-is, so fonts, images and page sizes are preserved exactly.

faqs.q: Can I merge password-protected PDFs?
faqs.a: Unlock them first with our Unlock PDF tool, then merge the unlocked files.

en.cta_p: Free and private. Drag in your files and merge in seconds.

en.why: Often you only need one page of a long document - a single invoice from a statement, one signed page from a contract, or a chapter from a book. Splitting lets you extract exactly what you need instead of sending a 200-page file.

steps.d: Add the PDF you want to split.

en.what: PDF to Word converts a PDF into a Microsoft Word .docx file.
